name: X Follower Spam Scanner
tagline: Audits your followers for spam, bots and hollow parody accounts, and asks before blocking
description: A quality check for your audience. It scans your followers for spam accounts, obvious bots, hollow parody or fan accounts, and impersonators, then reports what it found and waits: every block is confirmed with you before it happens. Useful after a viral moment, when the follower count jumps and not all of it is people.
author: HashCons
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
